from build123d import *

def build(p):
    La = p["leg_a_length"]
    Lb = p["leg_b_length"]
    t = p["thickness"]
    w = p["width"]
    d = p["hole_diameter"]

    pts = [(0, 0), (La, 0), (La, t), (t, t), (t, Lb), (0, Lb)]
    prof = Polygon(*pts, align=None)
    body = extrude(prof, amount=w, taper=p["draft"])
    feats = [{"tag": "bracket", "part": "bracket", "tools": [body]}]

    hole_a = Pos(p["hole_a_offset"], t / 2, w / 2) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(d / 2, t * 4)
    body = body - hole_a
    feats.append({"tag": "hole_leg_a", "part": "bracket", "tools": [hole_a]})

    hole_b = Pos(t / 2, p["hole_b_offset"], w / 2) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(d / 2, t * 4)
    body = body - hole_b
    feats.append({"tag": "hole_leg_b", "part": "bracket", "tools": [hole_b]})

    return {"parts": {"bracket": body}, "features": feats,
            "materials": {"bracket": "molded ABS"}}
